name: bible-challenge
description: Windows desktop app for scripture recall, Bible knowledge, and learning challenge modes.
author: Michael Kunze

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:admin && npm run test:e2e:no-build
scripts.test:e2e:no-build: set DEBUG=pw:browser,pw:api&& set DEBUG_COLORS=0&& node scripts/run-e2e-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:visual: npm run build && npm run build:admin && pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$env:DEBUG='pw:api,pw:browser'; npx playwright test --project=visual"
scripts.test:visual:update: npm run build && npm run build:admin && pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$env:DEBUG='pw:api,pw:browser'; npx playwright test --project=visual --update-snapshots"
scripts.test:all: npm run check:data && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:admin && npm run test:run && npm run test:admin && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:visual
scripts.build: npm run check:data && npm run typecheck && vite build
